name: Strict Digital Asset Review Rubric
purpose: Raises acceptance thresholds for production-ready assets where readability, navigation clearance, and telemetry usefulness must all be strong.

criteria.description: Assets must remain unmistakable from all review cameras and under agent FOV overlays.
Surface response, accent color, and emissive detail must communicate object role without labels.
Clearances must support path planning around tight layouts without confusing the viewer.
Assets must produce inspectable behavior events that help diagnose agent decisions.
Assets should remain lightweight, but visual clarity is weighted above budget pressure.
